items.q: I thank uh Johnny Garry for choosing me for one of those

ctx.x: Time for you to go, basically.

Basically, yeah. I felt insulted for them, you know. It wasn't quite fair to uh blink the lights … but anyway, it happened and uh, they all uh, uh, I think, uh lived through it, you know. But uh … Uh, I think uh, I thank uh Johnny Garry for choosing me for one of those … end up uh, uh, leading me to J.J.. I stayed with him at least a year or two.
When you were with J.J., were you mostly in the New York area?
